answer_2.quote: We follow the same evaluation metric as in FinQA, the execution accuracy to evaluate the final execution result and program accuracy to evaluate program equivalence.

answer_4.quote: We sample 200 example questions and distribute to both the expert and laymen annotators to answer. The two expert annotators reach an average execution accuracy of 89.44% and program accuracy of 86.34%, ... For the laymen performance, we distribute the samples to MTurk and end up with an execution accuracy of 46.90% and program accuracy of 45.52%.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered the sampled questions; performance was measured by execution accuracy and program accuracy.
